verbatim_source_excerpt: **INTC — 실적 가이던스 악화로 신규 매수 회피·위험 축소 관찰(watch_weaker).**
thesis: Oct 29 post-close Q3 revenue $16.5bn (+21% YoY), DCAI $7.3bn (+78%), CCPG $8.1bn (-5%); Q4 revenue guidance $15-16bn, non-GAAP EPS $0.25. Shares fell 28.58% Oct 30 on weaker forward outlook and high dilution/cash-burn risks.
counterevidence: Q3 data center and AI revenue rose 78% YoY, gross margin improved and supply expansion may improve long-run economics.
invalidation: Management raises verifiable guidance and PC demand stabilizes, cashflow and relative strength recover for multiple sessions.
entry_trigger: No fresh purchase. Watch only if a later session regains Oct 30 high $68.77 with verified volume, tight spread, relative strength versus SPY, and updated company news.
trigger_validity: 1-5 NYSE sessions 2026-11-02 through 2026-11-06 for tactical observation; longer 2-6 week and multi-month fundamental reassessment.
target_and_stop_basis: Oct 30 low $63.20 is a contextual reference, not an automatic stop. ATR, gap, validated resistance and execution spread needed before any entry/stop/first-profit target or R:R.
